RetroUI (neobrutalism/neobrutalism)

A React and Tailwind library published under the name NeoBrutalism, now branded RetroUI.

Source
neobrutalism/neobrutalism on GitHub
Creator
Arif Hossain
Made
2024–present
Style
Neo-brutalism (agent-proposed, not yet reviewed by a person)
Moods
Loud, playful
Evidence
Downloaded and inspected the README banner public/banner.png (1200 × 630). Licence read through the GitHub API. The live sites were not captured.
Reviewed
25 September 2026
Rights
Link and metadata only. License: unverified. Rights policy

Context

The GitHub description reads “A NeoBrutalism styled React + TailwindCSS UI library”. The README heading is “Retro UI”, with documentation at retroui.dev. On 2026-09-25 the page title of retroui.dev began “NeoBrutalism — Retro UI components for React”.

Repository created 31 August 2024 under the GitHub organization “NeoBrutalism.com”. MIT License, copyright 2024 Arif Hossain.

Observed

  • Heavy black condensed display type with a hard white-and-black offset, reading “Not every website has to look the same!”.
  • Mock browser windows with thick black frames, yellow title bars, and three-dot controls.
  • Cards inside the mock pages have black outlines and flat pastel or yellow fills.
  • Cartoon stickers (a yellow bird, cartoon eyes) have heavy black outlines.

Why it belongs

Shows the retro-window branch of the style that Malewicz and NN/g both describe: fake OS window chrome combined with outlines and hard shadows. The self-chosen name change to “Retro UI” also shows how close the neo-brutalist and retro-UI labels sit.

Borrow

A window frame with a colored title bar is a cheap, recognizable container in this style. Use it for product demos, not for every card.
